description: Get a Stripe billing-portal link for a Pro account: update the card, see invoices, switch between monthly and yearly, or cancel. A human must open it. Cancelling keeps Pro to the end of the paid period and never deletes a name. Answers 409 if the account has never subscribed (use upgrade_to_pro).

api_key.description: Your AgentDomains API key (adom_…). Only needed when this MCP connection has no `Authorization: Bearer` header, for example right after calling signup.

name: manage_billing
title: Get a billing portal link
